cohort: 84 patients who underwent cesarean delivery after 28 weeks gestation and hysterectomy performed either during cesarean delivery or within 24 hours after cesarean delivery at Ayub Medical Complex, Abbottabad between March 2011 and March 2012, aged 15-45 years.
finding: The most frequent factors leading to emergency cesarean hysterectomy were uterine atony (46.4%), followed by uterine rupture (32.1%), undiagnosed placenta previa (19.0%), and previous cesarean delivery (6.0%).
